title: OpenBot: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Openbot gives each agent its own container with its own Chromium login and workspace, so two co-workers aren't sharing a browser profile. Every tool call routes through one gateway that resolves the target, checks it against your rules, writes an audit row, and only then acts or refuses and names the rule. Any AGUI endpoint plugs in. It's alpha, ships with O disabled, and needs a Copel kit intelligence license to
